Project process

Know what happens
at every stage.

We agree on the goal and scope before I build. I then map the journey, connect the agreed pieces, test the important paths, and hand over the system clearly.

  1. 01

    Clarify

    We agree on the audience, offer, current tools, and the outcome your project needs to support.

  2. 02

    Map

    I map the page flow and show how information should move between your tools.

  3. 03

    Build

    I design the agreed pages, configure the workflows, and connect the tools in scope.

  4. 04

    Test and hand over

    I test the important paths and refine the details. You receive a clear handover for the system we built.

“I design the page, connect the follow-up, and make the handover clear.”
